description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve both Hammerhead abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
